documents.title: Quarterly Compliance Report on Corporate governance - within 21 days from the end of the quarter
Quarterly Compliance Report on Corporate governance - within 21 days from the end of the quarter

analysis.summary: Supreme Power Equipment Limited reported strong financial growth for H1 FY27, driven by healthy order book execution and robust end-market demand across key regions. Total Income grew 79.91% YoY to ₹135.57 Cr and Net Profit rose 45.09% YoY to ₹13.65 Cr, while EBITDA margin stood at 17.42%. Management highlighted that margins faced pressure from inflationary raw material costs, though price variation clauses in 70-75% of orders offer mitigation. Furthermore, the ramp-up of the newly inaugurated Kannur facility is progressing as planned, supporting higher-capacity transformer opportunities and an expanded order book of ₹565.80 Cr. Supreme Power Equipment Limited reported Q1 FY27 total income of INR48.31 crores and a net profit of INR4.9 crores.

guidance.claim: Management stated that EBITDA margins will be maintained between 18% and 20%.
guidance.quote: EBITDA margins will be maintained between 18% to 20%.

guidance.claim: PAT margins are expected to be around 9% to 12%.
guidance.quote: And the PAT margin will be around, we believe it will be around 9% to 12%.

guidance.claim: Management guides for a minimum 30% year-on-year rise in revenue.
guidance.quote: Year-on-year, 30% -- minimum 30% rise will be there on the revenue.

demand_outlook.claim: Business momentum remains encouraging as the company progresses in line with yearly targets.
demand_outlook.quote: Overall, business momentum remains encouraging, and we continue to progress in line with our targets for the year.

demand_outlook.claim: Strong growth reflects healthy execution of the order book and continued demand across key markets.
demand_outlook.quote: The strong growth reflects healthy execution of our order book and continued demand across our key markets.

demand_outlook.claim: Management notes that end-market demand is very high and expected to sustain for at least 10 years.
demand_outlook.quote: From the market information, at least minimum 10 years, this demand will sustain.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for transformers remains strong overall.
demand_outlook.quote: During Q1 FY27, our total income stood at INR48.31 crores, registering growth of 37.33 % year-on-year.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted sustained demand for their transformer solutions.
demand_outlook.quote: Q1 FY27 has been an encouraging start to the year, with our topline growing by over 37% year-on-year, underpinned by healthy execution momentum and sustained demand for our transformer solutions.

capex_expansion.claim: The ramp-up of the newly inaugurated Kannur facility is progressing well, with production and capacity utilisation scaling up as planned.
capex_expansion.quote: The ramp-up of our newly inaugurated Kannur facility is progressing well, with production and capacity utilisation scaling up as planned.

capex_expansion.claim: The new tank manufacturing facility capex is estimated around INR20 crores to INR22 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Yes, it's around INR20 crores, INR22 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to complete construction of the tank manufacturing facility before March.
capex_expansion.quote: I think before March, I think this facility will complete.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expanded its manufacturing capacity up to 9,000 MVA.

margins_costs.claim: Margins witnessed pressure during H1 FY27 primarily due to the inflationary environment and higher input costs across key raw materials.
margins_costs.quote: Margins witnessed some pressure during H1 FY27, primarily due to the inflationary environment and higher input costs, particularly across key raw materials.

margins_costs.claim: Around 70-75% of the order book is covered by price variation clauses, providing protection against significant movements in raw material prices.
margins_costs.quote: However, around 70–75% of our order book is covered by price variation clauses, which provides protection against significant movements in raw material prices and helps us manage cost volatility over the execution period.

margins_costs.claim: Employee benefit expenses increased due to the deployment of more than 250 people at the new plant.
margins_costs.quote: So now we have deployed more people for the new unit. So naturally, the employee benefits will high.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material price rises are being absorbed and passed through because of price variation clauses in the orders.
margins_costs.quote: So the margin was able to maintain and it was the reason it was absorbed, and it was passed out.

margins_costs.claim: Almost 80% to 85% of the order book is covered with a price variation clause.
margins_costs.quote: Almost 80%, 85% order which we are holding is covered with price variation clause.

margins_costs.claim: Margins witnessed some moderation during the quarter while profitability remained healthy.
margins_costs.quote: While margins witnessed some moderation during the quarter, profitability remained healthy and we continue to maintain a disciplined approach towards pricing, procurement and operational efficiency.

orders_capacity.claim: The company secured 11 orders with a cumulative value of ₹209.24 Cr during the first half, with execution timelines ranging from 7 to 17 months.
orders_capacity.quote: We secured 11 orders with a cumulative value of ₹209.24 Cr, with execution timelines ranging from 7 to 17 months.

orders_capacity.claim: The current order book stands at ₹565.80 Cr, providing healthy revenue visibility for the coming quarters.
orders_capacity.quote: Our current order book stands at ₹565.80 Cr, providing healthy revenue visibility for the coming quarters.

orders_capacity.claim: The total order book stands at INR590.06 crores as of August 13, 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: Our order book stands at INR590.06 crores as of August 13, 2026, providing healthy execution visibility over the coming quarters.

orders_capacity.claim: Government orders represent approximately 30.10% of the total order book and nongovernment orders represent 69.9%.
orders_capacity.quote: In terms of customer mix, government orders stand at INR177.6 crores, representing approximately 30.10% of the total order book, while nongovernment orders stands at INR412.46 crores, represent approximately 69.9%.

orders_capacity.claim: Power transformers constitute 76.91% of the order book.
orders_capacity.quote: From the product perspective, power transformers constitute the largest share on the order book at INR453.83 crores, representing approximately 76.91%.

orders_capacity.claim: Current utilization of the new plant is between 20% and 25%.
orders_capacity.quote: The new plant, our capacity is almost 20% to 25% utilization as of now.

orders_capacity.claim: The company secured 10 orders aggregating INR195.64 crores during Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: We secured 10 orders aggregating INR195.64 crores during Q1 FY27 with the execution time lines ranging between 7 months to 17 months.

orders_capacity.claim: The company secured 10 orders aggregating ₹195.64 Cr during the quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: We are particularly pleased with the strength of our order inflows during the quarter, having secured 10 orders aggregating ₹195.64 Cr.

orders_capacity.claim: The current consolidated order book stands at approximately ₹590.06 Cr.
orders_capacity.quote: Our current consolidated order book stands at approximately ₹590.06 Cr, providing healthy revenue visibility over the coming quarters.

capital_allocation.claim: The company plans to raise term loans from banks for the tank manufacturing capex.
capital_allocation.quote: Yes, we will be raising term loans for that.

capital_allocation.claim: There is no requirement for equity dilution for the current financial year.
capital_allocation.quote: So for this year, there is no requirement for equity dilution.

management_commitments.claim: The company remains focused on procurement efficiency, better product mix, and operating leverage as volumes scale up.
management_commitments.quote: We remain focused on procurement efficiency, better product mix and operating leverage as volumes scale up.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to complete between INR250 crores and INR300 crores of revenue this year.
management_commitments.quote: So cautiously, we are telling between INR250 crores to INR300 crores we can make this year.

management_commitments.claim: Out of the total order book, INR377 crores is scheduled for completion before March.
management_commitments.quote: Out of this INR590 crores as per the delivery requirement of the customers is INR377 crores should be completed before March.

management_commitments.claim: The new tank manufacturing facility construction is expected to be completed before March.
management_commitments.quote: I think before March, I think this facility will complete.

management_commitments.claim: The window for main board migration is expected to open after December.
management_commitments.quote: Main board, I think will be -- the window will be open after December.

management_commitments.claim: The immediate priority is the timely execution of the order book while progressively ramping up utilisation at the new manufacturing facility.
management_commitments.quote: Looking ahead, our immediate priority is the timely execution of this order book while progressively ramping up utilisation at our new manufacturing facility.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
